messages:
Samantha_Support: heads-up — AcmeCorp (dedicated pool dc-14) reports sudden 429s and intermittent 401s right after a plan change at ~08:09 UTC. Customer says calls that were fine are now getting throttled. attaching snippets and repro below.

albert_sre: can you drop the minimal repro and any request ids? i want to correlate with gateway logs.

Samantha_Support: repro curl: 
```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-acme-XX" -d '{"model":"rwd-3-large","input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Response seen: `{"error":"rate_limit_exceeded","code":429}`. request_id header: `req_0a1b2c3d`. Also saw short burst of `{"error":"unauthorized","code":401}` around 08:08:45 then back to 429.

mira_eng: interesting — timeline looks like billing plan flip at 08:07 from billing_ops UI. potential candidate: plan migration job touches quota service. i'll pull quota assignment logs.

billing_ops: confirmed: AcmeCorp plan tag flipped at 08:06:58 via admin migration. No errors surfaced in billing UI. Taging shows `enterprise-plus -> enterprise-plus-annual`.

jackie_infra: i see quota-service logged a config apply for tenant acme-corp at 08:07:01. Payload had `rate_units_denom: "hours"` instead of expected `minutes`. likely a denom flip during the migration pipeline.

albert_sre: that explains 60x change in effective rate window. if UI intended minutes but quota-service wrote hours, requests will suddenly exhaust. look at quota keys for req_0a1b2c3d.

noah_support: customer report also mentioned auth token rotation earlier in the day; could that have caused the 401 burst?

mira_eng: possible — token rotation touched KMS alias used by onboarding job. i see a short error when the onboarding lambda attempted to fetch plan metadata: `KMSAccessDenied: alias not found` at 08:06:52. onboarding retried and succeeded at 08:07:10. ordering looks like: token rotate -> onboarding fails briefly -> quota apply with wrong denom. race in migration script.

deploy-bot: [deploy] quota-service@staging promoted to prod at 07:55:12 UTC — release c3f2a8 includes plan-translation refactor.

jackie_infra: putting it together: new migration + transient KMS error -> fallback in migration code read legacy denom -> wrote `hours`. result: per-tenant cap effectively 60x lower than expected. autoscaler still fine; this is per-tenant rate unit misconfig, not GPU shortage. noisy neighbor not primary cause, but spikes made it look like neighbor eviction.

Samantha_Support: customer impact summary i sent them: 429 spikes from 08:09–08:20 UTC, brief 401 window ~08:08:45. told them engineers are investigating and rolling a hotfix.

mira_eng: proposed fix: patch migration script to validate denom field and abort on unknown values. hotfix patch PR #721 with guarded parsing. also add idempotent verify step: after applying, fetch effective quota and assert equality with expected (minutes).

albert_sre: mitigation for the customer: manual correct call to quota-service: 
```
POST /internal/admin/tenants/acme-corp/quota
{ "rate_units": 1000, "rate_units_denom": "minutes" }
```
I ran the admin-correct at 08:12:05 (req id admin_9z8y7). logs show subsequent requests succeeded (200s) within 30s.

billing_ops: also reverting the migration for AcmeCorp to the prior tag while we patch. no billing charges affected.

noah_support: customer confirmation: AcmeCorp confirmed recovery at 08:12:40 and provided app logs showing 200 responses. they're happy with rollback for now but want RCA.

mira_eng: next actions: 1) merge PR #721 and deploy to prod (priority). 2) add automated post-migration verification step. 3) add alert if quota denom != expected for the tenant type. 4) add a playbook step for support to run admin-correct quickly.

albert_sre: i'll follow up with a postmortem tomorrow and include queries: 
- query quota-service writes for last 24h where denom in ("hours","days") for dedicated tenants
- correlate KMS errors around migration times

Samantha_Support: thanks team. i'll send summary and next steps to AcmeCorp and flag for CS weekly review. :thumbsup:
